headline: Full Gate C (Option B, MD-INFORMED structural proxy — NOT PMF-resolved): verdict=qualified. On the Gate-B pore-concentrated A1 (sustained, non-autocatalytic) network, membrane permeability is informed by short Martini CG-MD of the amphiphile composition (long di-C16 bilayer thickness 2.87 nm vs short di-C12 2.325 nm; thicker long-chain core -> lower permeability 0.256 -> retention 0.661). Self-maintenance is the measurable ⚑1 criterion: (i) net amphiphile production 3.48e-05 >= degradation 1.00e-07 (maintained=True), AND (ii) the membrane beats the matched no-endogenous-membrane ablation at equal feeds on persistence 1.98x (pays=True) / throughput 0.79x (pays=False). Self-maintaining=True. The result is WINDOWED: integrity holds up to k_deg <= 0.01 1/s, and persistence benefit tracks the MD composition (thicker = more retention). NOT strict autopoietic closure; the metabolism is the A1 network, not autocatalytic (A2 refuted). PMF-resolved permeability (Option A, study og-32a) is the budgeted gold-standard follow-on.
